assessment_unit: All target instances for which both the imported target value and the corresponding source value could be uniquely identified and compared.
explanation: Checks whether values automatically imported between registry forms are identical to the corresponding recorded source values

assessment_unit: All instances of calculated values for which the target value and the source values required to reproduce the calculation were available.
explanation: Checks whether automatically calculated values are consistent with values independently recalculated from the recorded source variables using the implemented calculation formula.

assessment_unit: All dates in date_rules.csv, for which a rule is marked “True”.
explanation: Temporal Plausibility checks values against constraints defined in the date_rules table.

All dates marked with notAfterDeath = true for which both the assessed date and the patient’s date of death could be parsed.
All dates marked with notFuture = true that could be parsed successfully.
All patient-variable groups containing valid observations from at least two distinct episode dates.
explanation: Checks whether repeated measurements of selected variables for the same patient remain within predefined limits of variation across different episodes.

assessment_unit: All non-empty values for which data_type equals INTEGER
explanation: Checks whether recorded values are whole numbers.

assessment_unit: All non-empty values for which data_type equals FLOAT.
explanation: Checks whether recorded values are numerical.

assessment_unit: All non-empty values for which data_type equals BOOLEAN.
explanation: Checks whether recorded values are “true” or “false”.

assessment_unit: All non-empty values of enumerated data elements represented by single-choice inputs, assessed per patient, episode and data element to identify multiple recorded choices where only one value was expected
explanation: Checks whether enumerated types with single-choice input (radio buttons, dropdowns) contain only one recorded value.
